unchanged_exporter_contract.source_gate: Exact anchor HEAD, HEAD^{tree}, and empty porcelain status are checked before and after payload collection. The fixed terminal record additionally requires its original SHA256, status failed, source_sha and source_tree.
unchanged_exporter_contract.record_reads: The unchanged exporter recursively collects the one records directory using lstat, regular-file/nlink==1 and per-file 32 MiB checks, then ordinary read_bytes. It later rechecks device/inode/size/mtime and each retained file's SHA256.
unchanged_exporter_contract.limits: The original 128 MiB total-payload bound and original helpers/bin executable exclusion are unchanged. Actual files/exclusions/member count are not invented in this review.
unchanged_exporter_contract.write_scope: The configured new output directory must not exist; it is created with mode 0700. Archive, base64 parts, export.json and any caught failure.json are written only there. Fixed request keys/member prefixes contain no path traversal.
unchanged_exporter_contract.subprocess_scope: Only the original read-only Git identity/status commands are called by the exporter. The exporter contains no native/test dispatch, push/ref update, source reset, credential change, chmod/chown, or execution of the nested native JSON request.
unchanged_exporter_contract.archive_validation_scope: When actually run, the original exporter creates the tar.xz, reopens it, compares member-name set and each file's bytes with collected payloads, and reports archive hashes. It performs no extraction. Those are exporter actions to be performed, not independent archive verification performed in this static review.
unchanged_exporter_contract.file_race_claim_limit: This remains the original path-based lstat/read/recheck implementation. It is not an O_NOFOLLOW/O_PATH/descriptor-anchored atomic snapshot; this review does not claim those stronger guarantees.

serialization_boundary.note: The raw native request remains separately content-addressed. The unchanged exporter serializes its complete parsed request and observation objects using sorted, indented JSON with a trailing newline. Normalized archive members are not claimed byte-identical to the original raw JSON bodies. Exact original source/execution/log files are included through recursive records collection.
